## Scope

Describe the assigned task and files changed.

## Verification

List commands run and their results.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/INTERFACES.md`, and my task file.
- [ ] I modified only my assigned scope or documented owner agreement.
- [ ] Frozen public interfaces, units, shapes, and dtypes remain compatible.
- [ ] Expected test results were derived independently.
- [ ] Tests, lint, and type checks pass or failures are explained.
- [ ] New assumptions are documented.
- [ ] AI-generated code was reviewed line by line by a team member.
- [ ] Material AI use was recorded for the course report.
